video_title: Everyone Thought Dr. J Made $6 Million. They Were Wrong.

quotes.speaker: Julius Erving
quotes.summary_phrase: Julius Erving clarifies the reality of his $6 million contract
quotes.excerpt: I got a five-year contract for $3 million. I don't know why they call me the $6 million man.

text_blocks.speaker: Sanya Richards-Ross
text_blocks.text: What does that mean to you for the athletes that have come behind you, that you opened the door for them?

text_blocks.speaker: Julius Erving
text_blocks.text: They have so far surpassed economically the numbers we were negotiating for. In mine, they call me the $6 million man because there was a $6 million deal to get me from the New York Nets to the Philadelphia 76ers. The Nets got $3 million and I got a five-year contract for $3 million. I don't know why they call me the $6 million man. I didn't see $6 million.

quotes.speaker: Julius Erving
quotes.summary_phrase: Julius Erving critiques the modern NBA's four-second offensive routine
quotes.excerpt: They go through like a four-second routine, then they step three steps backwards and they take a shot.
quotes.quote: It seems to be a little bit more flash now. Everybody gets the ball, they go between legs, between legs around the back, and it's a routine. They go through like a four-second routine, then they step three steps backwards and they take a shot. It's all good because the referees have been told, look, the people aren't here to see y'all out there just blowing the whistle all the time. There is a lot of contact and a lot of extra steps that go on that they could blow the whistle on, and they would have maybe back in the day, but they try to keep it flowing.

quotes.speaker: Julius Erving
quotes.summary_phrase: Julius Erving dismisses the concept of an all-time greatest athlete
quotes.excerpt: There is no one athlete who you can look at in any sport and just say that was the best.
quotes.quote: There is no goat. There is no one athlete who you can look at in any sport and just say that was the best that ever did it. It's all an opinion.

quotes.speaker: Julius Erving
quotes.summary_phrase: Julius Erving lists his personal top five all-time basketball players
quotes.excerpt: I went with Chamberlain and Bill Russell, Elgin Baylor, Jerry West, and Oscar Robertson.
quotes.quote: I picked my top five when I was 15 years old. I have not let anybody mess that up. I went with Chamberlain and Bill Russell, Elgin Baylor, Jerry West, and Oscar Robertson. When you are 15 years old and you see those five out there, that's permanent.

quotes.speaker: Julius Erving
quotes.summary_phrase: Julius Erving explains why he disliked playing at Boston Garden
quotes.excerpt: You go in there in the winter, the locker room is too hot. You go in there in the spring, the locker room is too cold.
quotes.quote: You go in there in the winter, the locker room is too hot. You go in there in the spring, the locker room is too cold. They had all kinds of little stuff that was trickery. It was Red Auerbach at his best.
